LanguageData.Prairie.label: 草原
LanguageData.Prairie.description: Prairies are a type of temperate grassland. As the name suggests, it's mostly grass and sedge, with a few interspersed willows and oaks.
LanguageData.MontaneForest.label: montane forest
LanguageData.MontaneForest.description: Montane forest biomes are a found at mid-elevations. Not as dense as boreal forest and has no hardwood trees, though high rainfall leads to fast growth. May contain lakes.
LanguageData.MontaneGrasslands.label: montane birch grasslands
LanguageData.MontaneGrasslands.description: Montane grasslands are high-elevation tundra regions that contain relatively lush wildlife. The cold climate and high winds prevent forest growth, but many species of plant and wildlife can be found here. May contain small ponds and bogs.
